name: A month of books of a Kathmandu trading company, VAT-registered and filing monthly (fictitious)

documents.why: A domestic sale at the standard rate of 13 % (s. 7(1)): the value in box 1S and the output tax of box 1.

A sale the pack treats as exempt, tuition fees (education is listed as exempt by the secondary guides; Schedule 1 itself was not readable): the exempt row, no output tax, and a matched payment later on.
An export of goods, zero-rated under Schedule 2: the zero-rate row, no output tax, and a matched payment later on.

A domestic sale of fresh vegetables, exempt as a basic agricultural product (as the secondary guides list Schedule 1): it lands in the exempt row, not in the zero-rated one, and input tax on its costs is not deductible.
A health service, exempt (health is listed as exempt by the secondary guides): the exempt row again, no output tax.
A credit note for one unit returned from INV-001, so the standard-rated value and the output VAT fall back down and a sale_credit_note is exercised.

lines.name: Office stationery, retail sale — one unit returned

documents.why: A domestic purchase at the standard rate, deductible in full under s. 17(1): box 2 and its value row, and a matched payment later on.
A purchase of an exempt good (vegetables) from a supplier: no input tax, and the return has no row for an exempt purchase.
Staff training course fees, an education service the pack treats as exempt: no input tax, and the return has no row for an exempt purchase.
An import of goods: VAT charged at customs clearance under s. 5(1)(b), deducted under s. 17(1) through box 3, and held on the import VAT account until settled.

A consultancy service acquired from a supplier outside Nepal (s. 8(2)): the buyer assesses the tax and declares it in box 1R, and s. 17(5b) allows the deduction in box 2R, so the 1 300 is neutral for a fully taxable buyer.

Business entertainment, which the pack treats as a purchase whose input tax is blocked (the Rules of s. 17(2) were not readable and the user's accountant confirms): the 13 % is charged by the supplier but follows the expense to account 6530 and reaches no box.
A purchase credit note for a short delivery on PINV-001, so box 2 and its value row fall back down and a purchase_credit_note is exercised.

lines.name: Trading stock purchased for resale — short-delivery credit

payments.why: The tuition fees of INV-002 collected in full: a matched inbound payment on an exempt sale.
The export of INV-003 collected in full: a matched inbound payment in a foreign trade relationship.
PINV-001 settled in full, VAT included: a matched outbound payment.
An advance received from Example Export Buyer Pvt Ltd before its next shipment, matched to nothing: reconcile() has to survive an open item.
